_doc: The release cycle's ROTATION pool. Data, not code: every cycle builds the anchors (scripts/release_cycle.json) plus `picks_per_cycle` blueprints taken from `blueprints` in THIS ORDER -- never filesystem order, never at random: cycle k builds blueprints[(picks_per_cycle * k + i) mod n]. k counts the first-parent master commits since this file was added (scripts/release_cycle.py rotation_index). Every *.json beside this index must be listed in it. The hardwiring gate forbids each blueprint's id, name and vertical as a string literal in Factory code (scripts/scan_hardwiring.py form blueprint_name), so nothing in the Factory can branch on which blueprint is running.
